title: SEC Announces International Fraud Task Force Targeting ‘Pump-And-Dump’ Schemes
summary: The SEC has launched a cross-border task force to investigate offshore fraud and market manipulation, including pump-and-dump activity. Enforcement has extended to underwriters and auditors. It has also set a CFTC roundtable on Sept. 29 and will review governmental control factors abroad. title: McDowell County, West Virginia, birthplace of food stamps, faces a disappearing safety net
summary: For nonprofits in McDowell County, West Virginia, the federal cuts in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act threaten a lifeline. Many of McDowell’s 17,000 residents rely on federal programs and the nonprofits they fund to get by.
